Policy reasons · latest first
Demonstration, not a real device controller. All devices, sensor readings, identity, approvals and interlocks are simulated in your browser. No live weather lookup or long-term memory is used. Production enforcement must run on a trusted server; heater protection must run locally on real hardware. The preference selector represents consented memory for this session.
